headword: {悪口雑言|あっこうぞうごん}
gloss: all manner of abuse; torrent of insults

definitions.gloss: all manner of abuse; torrent of insults; stream of invective
definitions.explanation: A barrage of abusive language and insults. A four-character compound (四字熟語) that emphasizes the indiscriminate and relentless nature of the verbal attacks.

examples.japanese: {悪口雑言|あっこうぞうごん}を{浴|あ}びせる。
examples.english: To hurl a torrent of insults at someone.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{酔|よ}うと{悪口雑言|あっこうぞうごん}が{止|と}まらなくなる。
examples.english: When he gets drunk, his stream of insults doesn't stop.

examples.japanese: ネット{上|じょう}で{悪口雑言|あっこうぞうごん}を{書|か}き{連|つら}ねる{行為|こうい}は{許|ゆる}されない。
examples.english: The act of writing endless streams of abuse online is not acceptable.

notes: A four-character compound ({四字熟語|よじじゅくご}) combining {悪口|あっこう} (slander, bad-mouthing) and {雑言|ぞうごん} (abusive language). Note the reading: {悪口|あっこう} here uses the on'yomi, not the more common kun'yomi {悪口|わるくち} (speaking ill of someone). The compound conveys a more intense, literary tone than {悪口|わるくち} alone. Common collocation: {悪口雑言|あっこうぞうごん}を{浴|あ}びせる (to shower someone with abuse).
